# FreeLLMAgents

> Explore and compare AI models using reported capabilities, licensing, inference-provider availability, and published pricing.

## Main pages

- [AI model directory](https://freellmagents.com/): Browse and filter models by task, license, context window, provider availability, and reported pricing.
- [AI model comparison](https://freellmagents.com/model-comparison): Compare model specifications and published provider pricing.
- [AI cost calculator](https://freellmagents.com/cost-calculator): Estimate token costs using workload assumptions and published provider rates.
- [Inference providers](https://freellmagents.com/providers): Learn how provider availability and specifications are reported.
- [Model pricing](https://freellmagents.com/pricing): Learn how provider-specific rates are displayed.
- [About FreeLLMAgents](https://freellmagents.com/about): Read about the directory and its upstream data sources.
- [Contact](https://freellmagents.com/contact): Send a question, correction, or feedback.

## Data notes

- Model metadata and repository details come from Hugging Face Hub.
- Where available, provider availability and pricing are supplemented from Hugging Face Inference Providers.
- Upstream information can be incomplete or change. Confirm licensing and rates with the model publisher or provider.
